title: shot_list.json (contract v1)
description: Shared contract between workstreams A (generator), B (Artlist download), C (Premiere timeline), D (AI generation) and the orchestrator. Unknown extra fields are allowed so a workstream can carry its own metadata, but the fields listed here have fixed meaning.

drop_frame.description: True if start_tc values are drop-frame (only valid for 29.97/59.94). Drop-frame TCs use ';' before the frames field.

source_sequence.description: Name of the original Premiere sequence. Workstream C duplicates it to <name>_BROLL_v1.

approved.description: Shot IDs Jonathan approved for AI generation. Only a human edits this list.

generated.description: Shot IDs already generated (counts against max_clips).

start_tc.description: SMPTE HH:MM:SS:FF in sequence time at the list's fps.

duration_s.description: 3-8 s for video; music beds may be longer.

queries.description: Artlist search queries, most specific first (2-3).

file.description: Path relative to project_root, e.g. assets/S001.mp4. null until downloaded/generated.

ai_prompt.description: Prompt for ai_video / ai_audio / needs_ai shots (written by A or D).

error.description: Last failure message, if status is failed.
